# Objective

Implement approved G9B canonical projection schemas for spatial primitives on
`feature/g9b-canonical-primitive-projections`.

**PROPOSED FUTURE PROMPT — UNEXECUTED AND NOT AUTHORIZED.**

# Mandatory entry gate

Require global G9A (through G9A3) author-approved PASS, the normative primitive
sufficiency/projection-system contract, resolved staged families/guarantees,
clean branch, prompt hash and green composed verification. G9U1 is explicitly
not a mandatory gate.

# Hard dependencies

Author-approved G9A3 and its durable identity, lifecycle, ProjectionSystem,
diagram-map and frame-relation substrate are the only G9 implementation hard
dependency. G9U0, G9X1, G9U1 and G9O1 are not semantic prerequisites.

# Recommended execution predecessor

Start as soon as G9A3 is approved. The integrated schedule may place U0/X1/U1
first for delivery convenience, but that ordering cannot block G9B or enter its
sufficiency certificate.

# Global/release gate

G9B author approval is the hard predecessor of G9C and supplies the primitive
track to global G9 closeout. It does not by itself authorize G9C or U2.

# Authority and evidence hierarchy

Read implemented G9A source, current 2D/3D primitive algorithms and serialization,
then approved spatial spec, analytic equations and validation matrix.

# Scope

Implement type-specific schemas in approved stages for line, segment, ray,
vector, plane, circle, conic and supported spatial curve; reconstruction,
intrinsic reprojection, typed induced actions through declared diagram maps,
ProjectionSystem consistency, degeneracy and dynamic certificates.

# Explicitly forbidden scope

No fixed view-count rule, silhouettes as primitive authority, label/proximity
correspondence, generic opaque 3D conversion, G9C composites, U2 procedures,
CAD feature tree, or unsupported guarantee promotion.

# Editable boundaries

Additive GeoCeDG shared spatial schema packages, minimum kernel integrations,
canonical models/tests, verifier/evidence/docs and registered upstream edits.

# Productive versus test-private permissions

Only explicitly approved family stages are productive. Later-family fixtures
and numerical pilots remain test-private.

# Architectural placement

Sufficiency, reconstruction and reprojection affect semantic meaning and belong
in the shared kernel DAG; views only render derived representations.

# Required design/specification

For every family implement allowed frames, minimum data by configuration,
constructive correspondence, rank/nondegeneration, equations, guarantees,
consistency residuals and atomic status publication. Keep intrinsic equations
`q_i=pi_i(x)` separate from common-diagram coordinates `p_i=delta_i(q_i)`;
validate typed map families/hinge relations and preserve common-gauge
invariance. Viewport transforms are never semantic inputs.

# Geometric invariants and degeneracies

Cover projecting/collapsed lines and planes, zero-length linear objects,
collinearity, support-plane loss, conic degeneration, curve parameter
correspondence, inconsistent/ambiguous/underdetermined states and recovery.

# Compatibility and serialization

Use G9A identities/versions; old files remain unassociated. Unsupported schema
versions or families publish typed status, never a guessed spatial object.

# Required tests and commands

Run analytic/reprojection, dynamic singular passage, lifecycle/roundtrip,
intrinsic/diagram round trips, typed induced-map composition, invalid hinge or
map states, common-gauge invariance, dynamic singular passage, lifecycle/
roundtrip, zoom/camera/label/layer independence, stable identity and
deterministic counters for each staged family; focused G9B and composed
verification.

# Required artifacts

Source/tests/canonical models, capability matrix, scientific references,
benchmarks, verifier, machine evidence, traceability and phase reports.

# Stop conditions

Stop if sufficiency depends only on view count, correspondence must be inferred,
reprojection fails tolerance, or a failed certificate leaves stale geometry.
